case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Your offer gives us a clear basis, and our proposal is built around what a supplier with tight capacity needs most: a binding volume it can plan with. Option A gives Ravensteiner a firm commitment over a long contract term, so your allocation can be planned with certainty.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Option A is the package we can approve. It pairs a binding annual volume and a longer term with a price and lead time that reflect that security, and with those delivery and price records in view, we think it is a fair balance for both sides.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

If the step goes beyond your own authority, please take Option A to your pricing committee. For Ravensteiner it means a binding volume for the full contract term, a steady and predictable order flow, and a customer that commits firmly in return for a reliable supply.

I look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have verified your records; however, historical pricing is not applicable given our current high capacity utilisation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In exchange for accepting the 24-month term, we must trade the lead time back to 54 days to keep the price from rising further.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Our offer provides a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.90 per unit. This alternative package offers a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for checking the records and for setting out your final offer so clearly. We accept your alternative proposal as offered, with the longer lead time in exchange for the lower unit price, and we understand that this is what keeps your capacity planning reliable.

Option A gives Ravensteiner what a supplier with a full order book needs most: a binding volume over a long contract term, so your allocation can be planned with certainty. It is the package we can approve.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.90; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your acceptance of our terms and the 56-day lead time. This Lieferzeit of 56 days aligns with our current capacity planning requirements. 

Regarding our Angebot, we hold to a price of €31.90 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. We accept this package and will proceed with the order confirmation. This offer remains valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
